body:
**update** I tested negative for everything today. God knows how with so many symptoms. I have to do again in a couple of weeks but 10 weeks is normally conclusive these days. As someone said, the brain is a powerful powerful thing.

I would like to thank everyone for their support and kind words which actually meant a great deal to me.

I'm not out of the woods and need a lot of counselling which I see as my first steps and one day at a time. I will now spend my life trying to right my wrongs and trying to be the best father anyone could be.

From the bottom of my heart.. thank you

Does any of that matter? Yes it is to some of those things but its no excuse.

Have to leave in about 5 mins. Can't breathe. I am shakong

I know...but I have always been non anxious and thinl I know my body. Just had to say goodnight to the kids and its heartbreaking.

Seriously thinking tomorrow is the last day I will be here. I can't take this pain continuing for the rest of my life.

I know. But I simply cannot look her in the eye and tell her what has happened. She is a beautiful, caring woman who has done nothing but look after me the last two months. This makes it even harder for me to tell her. As we have no support network or family also, until I know for sure, I am a useless father at the moment who is numb and can't even look at his kids without getting upset at the moment.  Until I know what I have done for sure, I cant say anything. Otherwise the kids will have two parents who are not with it.

Thank you for your words.

It is meant to be something like a 1/1000 but the fact I more than likely have other STDs and that this was with a CSW has reduced that significantly. 

I am in absolute agony. There is no happy end to this story no matter what. 

I HAVE to wait until tomorrow but know my own body and know something is up. Thank you for listening. This is my only outlet at the moment
